(Statista, 2023). These statistics show a clear trend that eLearning is becoming 
a more popular resource for education inside and outside of the classroom. 
With the eLearning adoption boom, many schools shifted to online assessments 
and online lectures that could either be completed asynchronously or 
synchronously (Wilhelm, et al., 2022). Tutoring which could only previously be 
done with another human, is now being automated with tools such as ChatGPT, 
making home tutoring highly accessible no matter the students household 
income (Grassini, 2023). (Kew & Tasir, 2022) claims that eLearning’s 
effectiveness is greatly improved by analysing the students’ performance and 
providing personalised material. These analytics with some applications are also 
sent to teachers, to help them diagnose issues with the entire classes 
understanding. 
The eLearning industry through-out history has rapidly taken up new 
technologies, to again a competitive advantage over competition. With recent 
innervations like ChatGPT, and new content delivery platforms, the eLearning 
experience is likely to continue its trend of becoming ever more effective and 
engaging.
